items.question: Will OpenAI and Stripe move ACP to a neutral foundation?
items.context: The governance document names a foundation as a long-term goal with four preconditions; today the founders appoint the TSC and hold a veto on SEPs.

items.question: What do the six newer checkout statuses mean?
items.context: incomplete, requires_escalation, pending_approval, complete_in_progress and expired, plus authentication_required, appear in the schema; the RFC status list omits all six and only authentication_required has behavior in the RFC text, so five have no RFC definition.

items.question: Does ACP checkout still run anywhere besides ChatGPT's marketplace payment sheet, and who else runs it in production?
items.context: No source answers it as of 2026-11-14. OpenAI's plugin guidelines still list Instant Checkout as a beta for select marketplace partners, and Checkout.com, Worldpay and PayPal document ACP for ChatGPT, but OpenAI's rewritten commerce docs and ChatGPT Wallet do not mention ACP. Microsoft, PayPal and Walmart made announcements, and Microsoft's later merchant page asks for UCP feeds. Even Meta, the third TSC member, documents no ACP use for its own agent Muse.

items.question: Will OpenAI's implementation and the spec converge, or part ways?
items.context: OpenAI's current statements point two ways. Its merchant page says ChatGPT shopping is built on ACP and that ACP will expand to the full shopping journey, while its commerce docs, rewritten on 2026-11-13, no longer mention ACP (both as of 2026-11-14). Its Ads Delta Feeds API and the Draft view of its feed schema follow ACP's feed shapes without naming ACP, and its plugin reference checkout follows UCP's field names. The older differences on feed paths, webhook names, status codes and TLS describe docs that OpenAI replaced in that rewrite.

items.question: Which ChatGPT surfaces will ChatGPT Wallet reach?
items.context: The text of OpenAI's post names dots for US ChatGPT Pro subscribers as the first surface, while the post's own page description and OpenAI's RSS summary name agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex and dots (2026-11-14). Either way Wallet pays on the merchant's existing checkout and is not presented as ACP.

items.question: Will ACP get a user-intent layer?
items.context: The Verifiable Intent project proposes carrying its credentials through ACP extensions; the maintainers have not adopted it.

items.question: How should PSPs report allowance violations?
items.context: ACP defines the allowance but no error codes for a charge outside it, so each PSP picks its own.

items.question: Is the repository still active?
items.context: No commit, tag or release landed between 2026-07-18 and 2026-11-14, after 18 commits following the 2026-04-17 release, and no maintainer commented, reviewed or merged in that window. A dispute-resolution extension SEP (PR 316, 2026-10-16) awaits a sponsor although a comment marked it ready for maintainer review on 2026-11-06, and issue 315 asks for stored agent identity. The repository still describes the specification as maintained by OpenAI and Stripe.

items.question: How much commerce runs over ACP?
items.context: No official volume, GMV or merchant count exists; the only figures are partner lists and a reported remark that about a dozen Shopify merchants sold through AI tools in March 2026.
